page.layout: One column of running text, page number at top right. Below the last line, a signature mark at centre and a catchword at right. Ragged fragments along the left edge are not printed text of this page and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: Quare cum ipse ante & post tempora Pho-tij testimonia Graecorum eo aeuo praeclarissimorum profert, eadem ipsa, quae & Pontificij dicunt, enunciantium, nemo nisi perfatuus consensionem, etiam si prava a nonnullis reputetur, in dubio ponet. Hinc concludo: Tarasius, Nicephorus Patriarchae Constantinopolitani, Theodorus Studita, Simeon Metaphrastes, Maximus Homologeta, Basilius, Leo Imperatores Graecorum, Pontifices ipsi Romani ad cosdem [?] Graecos scribentes, a quibus nullo negotio de mendacio, atque de usurpata indebite auctoritate argui poterant, ipse Photius Ecclesiae Romanae hostis infensissimus: hi omnes non ex trunco, aut stipite, sed cum primis illustres scientijs, virtutibus, & di-gnitatibus clari, & ab ipsis Graecis etiam schismaticis in maximo pretio habiti, & maxima veneratione culti, dictis factisque fatentur, Romanum Pontificem primas partes in universa Ecclesia obtinere, illius esse & Ecclesias corrigere, & corripere, dogmata stabilire, minis etiam & poenis inflictis Ecclesiasticas personas, cuiuscunque sint gradus & dignitatis, ad sua placita compellere, &, si mandatis non obtemperauerint, poenam ab eis ob contumaciam expetere, &, quidquid ipsi egerint, irritum de-

page.notes: Left edge: several cropped word fragments (e.g. "it", "la", "ut", "t") run down the left side of the page. They are edge or show-through material, not part of the text, and were left out. "cosdem" is uncertain: the scan reads "cofdem"; the reading is marked [?]. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout; the printed "ff" in "praeclariffimorum", "infensiffimus" and "consensionem" stands for double s. Catchword "cla-" and signature "S" are shown in bottom_margin. A small mark below the text at left is not printed text and was left out.
